name: members-price
description: Shopify Function / Metafield / Liquid snippet which outputs a Members price on the PDP and applies a discount at checkout.
summary: Applies special member prices automatically to products for logged-in customers on the Alpkit Shopify store, showing discounts on product pages and applying them in the cart and checkout. Store managers and marketers use it to reward members with discounted prices without needing manual code entry or separate discount codes. This removes confusion and ensures members always get their special pricing seamlessly throughout their shopping experience.
